name: ScrimForge
tagline: Enterprise-grade coaching operations for competitive gaming teams.
positioning: ScrimForge turns ad-hoc scrim reviews and VOD notes into a standardized coaching pipeline your roster can actually execute against.

hero.h1: Run your coaching staff like a real operation.
hero.sub: ScrimForge standardizes VOD reviews, scrim scheduling, and player development plans so owner-operators can scale a roster without living in spreadsheets and Discord pins.

features.title: Structured VOD review
features.description: Timestamp mistakes, tag them to macro or mechanics, and auto-generate a review packet each player sees before the next scrim block.

features.title: Scrim scheduling
features.description: Lock scrim blocks across time zones, sync availability from every player, and stop losing practice slots to calendar chaos.

features.title: Development plans
features.description: Assign per-player drills with measurable targets and track whether reps actually translate to in-game improvement.

features.title: Roster analytics
features.description: One dashboard for KDA trends, objective control, and comp win rates so you coach on data, not vibes.

features.title: Coaching SOPs
features.description: Templated playbooks and review checklists keep every assistant coach delivering the same quality of feedback.

features.title: Match-day readiness
features.description: Pre-game briefs, opponent scouting notes, and comp drafts consolidated into a single approved game plan.

testimonials.quote: We went from three coaches with three note-taking styles to one review pipeline. Our academy players now walk into scrims knowing exactly what to fix.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: As the owner I finally see what my coaching staff is actually delivering. ScrimForge made our development program something I can put in a sponsor deck.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: Scheduling scrims across two rosters used to eat my whole week. Now it's automated and I coach instead of chasing DMs.
testimonials.name: Diego Vargas
